songs.title: Stay
songs.stylePrompt: warm acoustic pop, I-V-vi-IV progression, gentle stop-time break before the final chorus, 92 BPM, tender intimate mood
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Sunlight falls across the old back porch
The kettle hums a slow familiar song
I trace the grain of wood beneath my hand
Another quiet afternoon rolls on

[Chorus]
Stay Here With Me
The evening always finds its own slow pace
The garden light still warm against the wall
Stay Here With Me

[Verse 2]
The garden gate creaks open in the breeze
A paper note still folded on the shelf
I keep the porch light burning after dark
Waiting for the sound of your own step

[Chorus]
Stay Here With Me
Don't let the evening pull you far away
Stay Here With Me
The porch light waits until you're home to stay

[Bridge]
Maybe the years will soften every mile
Maybe the road will finally bring you back

[Chorus]
Stay Here With Me
Don't let the evening pull you far away
Stay Here With Me
The porch light waits until you're home to stay

youtube.title: Stay
youtube.description: A heartfelt addition to your listening pack.

songs.title: Carry Home
songs.stylePrompt: soft mid-tempo pop, ii-V-I progression, subtle key change lifting the last chorus, 100 BPM, warm nostalgic mood
songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The last bus rolls down an empty avenue
Streetlights blink awake one by one
I count the stops until the road turns familiar
Every mile a little closer to done

[Chorus]
The fields blur past in gentle shapes tonight
Carry Me Home
The radio hums a tune I half recall
Carry Me Home

[Verse 2]
The radio hums an old forgotten tune
Window cracked to let the night air in
I watch the fields blur into gentle shapes
And feel the weight of the day begin to thin

[Chorus]
Carry Me Home
Through every turn I know so well
Carry Me Home
Where the porch steps still remember my name

[Bridge]
Every road I've taken led me back again
Every light still burning just the same

[Chorus]
Carry Me Home
Through every turn I know so well
Carry Me Home
Where the porch steps still remember my name

youtube.description: A heartfelt addition to your listening pack.
